title: Parser: Shopee Orders CSV
description: parse_shopee_orders reads shopee_orders.csv, maps columns to internal OrderRow schema, returns 50 rows with channel='shopee'

title: Parser: TikTok Orders CSV
description: parse_tiktok_orders reads tiktok_orders.csv, maps columns to internal OrderRow schema, returns 50 rows with channel='tiktok'

title: Parser: Shopee Inventory CSV
description: parse_shopee_inventory reads shopee_inventory.csv, maps columns to internal InventoryRow schema, returns 50 rows with channel='shopee'

title: Parser: TikTok Inventory CSV
description: parse_tiktok_inventory reads tiktok_inventory.csv, maps columns to internal InventoryRow schema, returns 50 rows with channel='tiktok'

title: Parser: COGS CSV
description: parse_cogs_csv reads internal_cogs_hpp.csv, returns 50 COGSRow dicts with sku, hpp_per_unit, brand, supplier fields

title: Parser: missing required column raises error
description: If a CSV is missing a required column (e.g. sku_reference_no), parser raises an exception with a message naming the missing column

title: Parser: invalid numeric row returns warning
description: If a row has non-numeric value in a numeric column, parser skips the row and includes a warning string in the warnings list

title: Parser: empty CSV returns empty list
description: A CSV with only a header row and no data rows returns an empty list, not an error

title: Parser: dot-separated numbers handled
description: Numeric values like '129.000' (Indonesian format) are parsed correctly as 129000 by stripping dots before int conversion

title: Parser: UTF-8 BOM encoding handled
description: CSV files saved with UTF-8 BOM (utf-8-sig) are parsed correctly without the BOM appearing in column names

title: DB: SQLite init creates cogs table
description: Calling init_db creates the cogs table in SQLite if it does not exist. Table has columns: sku, product_name, category, brand, supplier, hpp_per_unit, last_updated

title: DB: bulk insert COGS data
description: Inserting 50 COGS rows via bulk insert stores all 50 in the database. SELECT * returns 50 rows.

title: DB: bulk insert replaces duplicates
description: Inserting a COGS row with an existing SKU replaces the old row (INSERT OR REPLACE). No duplicate SKUs in table.

title: DB: update single SKU HPP
description: Updating hpp_per_unit for one SKU via update function changes only that row. Other rows unchanged.

title: DB: delete single SKU
description: Deleting one SKU removes it from the table. Count decreases by 1.

title: DB: get all COGS returns dict keyed by SKU
description: get_all_cogs returns a dict mapping sku -> hpp_per_unit for use by the calculation engine

title: Engine: margin positive classified correctly
description: An order where actual_unit_price > hpp * 1.2 is classified as level='positive'

title: Engine: margin warning classified correctly
description: An order where actual_unit_price is between hpp and hpp * 1.2 is classified as level='warning'

title: Engine: margin negative classified correctly
description: An order where actual_unit_price < hpp is classified as level='negative' with negative margin value

title: Engine: margin sorted by loss
description: calculate_margins output is sorted with level='negative' first, then by margin ascending (biggest loss at top)

title: Engine: unmapped SKU skipped with warning
description: If an order's SKU is not in the COGS dict, it is excluded from margin_alerts and added to unmapped_skus list

title: Engine: budget safe level
description: Total loss <= 50% of campaign_budget returns meter_level='safe'

title: Engine: budget caution level
description: Total loss between 51-80% of campaign_budget returns meter_level='caution'

title: Engine: budget over level
description: Total loss > 80% of campaign_budget returns meter_level='over'

title: Engine: budget zero division safe
description: campaign_budget=0 returns pct_used=0 and meter_level='safe', no ZeroDivisionError

title: Engine: run rate calculation
description: Given 10 units sold over 2 hours, run_rate_per_hour = 5.0

title: Engine: stockout prediction time
description: Given run_rate=5/hr and channel_stock=20, hours_until_stockout=4.0 and stockout_time is 4 hours from now

title: Engine: zero velocity returns infinity
description: SKU with no orders (velocity=0) returns hours_until_stockout=inf and stockout_time=None, not an error

title: Engine: zero stock returns zero hours
description: SKU with channel_stock=0 returns hours_until_stockout=0 and level='negative'

title: Engine: run rate sorted by stockout
description: Output sorted by hours_until_stockout ascending. Infinity values at the bottom.

title: Engine: rebalance detects starved channel
description: SKU with shopee_stock=0, tiktok_stock=30, warehouse_stock=500 returns level='warning' with recommendation to replenish Shopee

title: Engine: rebalance ignores balanced SKU
description: SKU with shopee_stock=50, tiktok_stock=40, warehouse_stock=200 is not included in rebalance output (level='positive', filtered out)

title: Engine: rebalance ignores low warehouse
description: SKU with shopee_stock=0 but warehouse_stock=30 (<=50) is not flagged for rebalance

title: Engine: rebalance warehouse-only SKU
description: SKU exists in warehouse but not in any marketplace inventory -> shown with shopee_stock=0, tiktok_stock=0

title: API: POST /api/cogs/upload stores data
description: Uploading internal_cogs_hpp.csv to POST /api/cogs/upload returns 200 with inserted=50. GET /api/cogs returns 50 rows.

title: API: GET /api/cogs returns all COGS
description: After uploading COGS, GET /api/cogs returns JSON with data array and count field

title: API: PUT /api/cogs/<sku> updates HPP
description: PUT /api/cogs/SKU-SUNSCREEN-01 with {hpp_per_unit: 70000} returns 200. Subsequent GET shows updated value.

title: API: PUT /api/cogs/<sku> returns 404 for unknown SKU
description: PUT /api/cogs/SKU-NONEXISTENT returns 404

title: API: DELETE /api/cogs/<sku> removes SKU
description: DELETE /api/cogs/SKU-SUNSCREEN-01 returns 200. Subsequent GET /api/cogs count decreases by 1.

title: API: POST /api/analyze returns full analysis
description: Uploading 4 sample CSVs + campaign_budget=5000000 to POST /api/analyze returns 200 with margin_alerts, budget_status, run_rate, rebalance, unmapped_skus, warnings, summary_text

title: API: POST /api/analyze detects negative margins
description: Using sample data, margin_alerts contains entries with level='negative'. At least 9 from Shopee + 8 from TikTok.

title: API: POST /api/analyze returns budget status
description: budget_status contains total_loss, campaign_budget, remaining, pct_used, and meter_level fields

title: API: POST /api/analyze returns run rate
description: run_rate array contains entries with run_rate_per_hour, hours_until_stockout, and stockout_time fields

title: API: POST /api/analyze returns rebalance
description: rebalance array contains entries where marketplace stock <= 5 and warehouse > 50

title: API: POST /api/analyze missing file returns 400
description: Sending only 3 of 4 required CSV files returns 400 with error message

title: API: POST /api/analyze bad CSV returns 400
description: Uploading a CSV with missing required columns returns 400 with error naming the missing column

title: API: POST /api/analyze includes summary_text
description: Response contains summary_text field with plain text starting with 'RINGKASAN MARKETPLACE MONITOR'

title: API: GET /api/sample-data loads demo
description: GET /api/sample-data returns 200 with same response shape as POST /api/analyze, using files from data/ folder

title: Frontend: page loads with empty state
description: GET / returns 200 with HTML containing upload slots, empty state instructions, and 'Muat Data Sample 10.10' button

title: Integration: full pipeline with sample data
description: Upload COGS CSV, then upload 4 marketplace CSVs with budget=5000000, verify response contains all 5 sections with correct data from simulation

title: Integration: COGS persists across requests
description: Upload COGS, restart Flask test client, GET /api/cogs still returns data (SQLite persistence)

title: Integration: sample data matches simulation
description: GET /api/sample-data returns margin_alerts with at least 15 negative-level entries (9 Shopee + 8 TikTok from simulated data)

title: Parser: Latin-1 encoding fallback
description: When CSV content is encoded in Latin-1 / ISO-8859-1 rather than UTF-8, parser falls back to Latin-1 decoding without raising UnicodeDecodeError

title: Parser: header case-insensitivity and whitespace
description: CSV column matching is case-insensitive and trims leading/trailing whitespace (e.g. ' SKU_reference_no ' matches required 'sku_reference_no')

title: Parser: warehouse inventory CSV
description: parse_warehouse_inventory reads master_warehouse_inventory_cogs.csv and returns dict mapping sku -> warehouse_physical_stock

title: Parser: duplicate order IDs preserved
description: Multiple rows sharing the same order_id representing multi-item orders are all parsed without deduplication

title: Parser: non-CSV binary file raises error
description: Uploading corrupted or binary data that cannot be parsed as CSV raises an error

title: DB: get single SKU details
description: get_cogs_by_sku returns the full row dictionary for an existing SKU and None for a non-existent SKU

title: DB: empty database returns empty dict
description: get_all_cogs on an empty database returns an empty dictionary without errors

title: DB: update single SKU preserves other fields
description: Updating hpp_per_unit leaves product_name, category, brand, and supplier values unchanged

title: Engine: budget calculates loss with order quantity
description: An order with qty > 1 and negative margin multiplies abs(margin) by qty to calculate accurate total loss

title: Engine: budget remaining can be negative
description: When total_loss exceeds campaign_budget, remaining is negative and pct_used is greater than 100.0

title: Engine: run rate aggregates multiple orders per SKU
description: When multiple orders exist for the same SKU and channel, run rate sums all quantities and calculates hours from earliest order

title: Engine: stockout level thresholds classification
description: SKUs with hours_until_stockout < 2 are classified as 'negative', 2-6 hours as 'warning', and >= 6 hours as 'positive'

title: Engine: inventory SKUs without orders omitted from run rate
description: SKUs in inventory that have no sales in orders are excluded from run_rate list (velocity cannot be determined)

title: Engine: rebalance recommendation text and cap calculation
description: Recommendation string follows 'Replenish {channel} (+{qty} unit)' and caps transfer at min(100, wh_stock // 2)

title: Engine: rebalance detects both channels starved
description: SKU with shopee_stock <= 5 and tiktok_stock <= 5 with warehouse > 50 generates replenishment recommendations for both channels

title: Engine: rebalance sorted by warehouse stock descending
description: Rebalance output is sorted by warehouse_stock descending so SKUs with highest idle stock appear first

title: Summary: generate WhatsApp summary text format
description: generate_summary_text produces formatted plain text with header, BUDGET line, ALERT JUAL RUGI, PREDIKSI HABIS, and PERLU REPLENISH sections

title: Summary: WhatsApp summary Rupiah number formatting
description: Summary text formats Rupiah values with dot separators (e.g. 'Rp 5.000.000') and percentages rounded to 1 decimal

title: Summary: WhatsApp summary with zero losses and empty alerts
description: When there are no negative margin orders or critical stockouts, summary generates clean zero-count sections without crashing

title: Summary: alert card copy text generation
description: generate_alert_copy_text generates exact format 'ALERT: {sku} ({name}) jual rugi -{margin}/unit di {channel}. Harga jual Rp {actual}, HPP Rp {hpp}. Segera cek voucher.'

title: API: POST /api/cogs/upload missing file returns 400

description: POST /api/cogs/upload with missing required column (e.g. 'hpp_per_unit') returns 400 Bad Request

description: PUT /api/cogs/<sku> with missing or non-integer hpp_per_unit returns 400 Bad Request
